summary: Added meterbill/money.py (round_amount, allocate, legacy_cents, fixed, with exact integer arithmetic and no use of the decimal context), routed every rounding and fixed-place format in tariffs, standing, tax, cash, credits, bill, batch and report through it, and removed the getcontext line from __init__.py. Kept quirks as they were: batch bills round band charges and the effective price half even (worker threads never had the half-up context) while bill/quote/tariffs round half up, VAT stays half even, cash 'whole' never yields a negative zero, and the 28-digit precision of plain decimal arithmetic is still the default context's. Verified with the unchanged tests, a new tests/test_money.py and a differential fuzz of every command against the original package, with no output differences.
